appraisal_events.evidence: Il me semblait d'ailleurs que ses moindres tableaux, à lui, étaient quelque chose d'autre que les chefs-d'œuvre de peintres même plus grands. Son œuvre était comme un royaume clos, aux frontières infranchissables, à la matière sans seconde.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator sharply elevates Elstir above even greater painters, framing his lesser works as belonging to an entirely separate, unmatched artistic realm.

status_effects.explanation: Elstir is portrayed as artistically incomparable, his work set apart from and above that of even more renowned painters in the narrator's settled judgment.
